newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ekran chief to detail restructuring soon.
newsitem.headline: Ekran chief to detail restructuring soon.

text.p: Ekran Bhd chairman Ting Pek Khiing said on Wednesday that he would announce a restructuring of companies controlled by him "very soon".
He told reporters that the restructuring would involve "a few" and not all of the five companies controlled by him.

"We are doing final touch-ups...I think we will finalise in a few days' time. It's very soon now," Ting said after the annual general meeting of Wembley Industries Bhd, a property developer and industrial concern controlled by him.
He declined to give further details.
Stock market players have speculated that Ting will restructure his companies under Ekran, the main developer of the Bakun hydroelectric dam, to raise cash.

Ekran recently completed a poorly received rights issue of 257.1 million shares which was undersubscribed by 62.77 percent. The results forced Ting to pick up over 90 percent of the unwanted portion for 859.8 million ringgit.
Ting controls three other listed companies apart from Ekran and Wembley.
They are timber products company Pacific Chemical Bhd, engineering firm PWE Industries, and property and timber concern Granite Industries Bhd.
